cards.title: Textile Fragment
cards.extract: This fragment, one of several in the collection, is a rare survivor of catastrophic rains that destroyed much of the Moche textile legacy and may have helped to bring about the decline of Moche culture. It depicts a serpent and a snail beneath a hovering raptorial bird—perhaps a snail kite, a type of hawk named after its favored food. The size of the motifs implies that the original textile was large; a mantle (a shawl-like garment) or a hanging are among the possibilities.

cards.title: Tesla "winding down" production of Cybertruck
cards.extract: According to a recent tweet by Tesla founder Elon Musk, the company will be decreasing its production of the Cybertruck electric vehicle at its Texas Gigafactory two and a half years after the car's debut. cards.title: Concrete House / Vierna9 + CIRAL Arquitectos
cards.extract: The location, program, and construction define the project for this residence, located in the northwestern part of Madrid , where the use of concrete becomes the defining feature of its architectural identity.
